title: Metrizable profinite quotients through which a metric-valued function factors
statement: Let $S$ be a profinite space (compact Hausdorff with a basis of clopen sets), let $G$ be a profinite group (compact Hausdorff with a basis of open normal subgroups), let $r\geq1$ be an integer, and let $(Y,d_Y)$ be a metric space, with no completeness hypothesis. For every continuous $f:S\times G^r\to Y$ there exist a metrizable profinite space $S_0$, a metrizable profinite group $G_0$, continuous surjections $p:S\to S_0$ and $q:G\to G_0$, with $q$ a group homomorphism, and a continuous $f_0:S_0\times G_0^r\to Y$ such that $f=f_0\circ(p\times q^r)$. The empty $S$ is allowed. All spaces use [def-weil-size-convention].
